title: 第一卷 第115章 郝大能心态崩了！

第(1/3)页

听到这，王建军便让李南枝进来看着妈，他便跟着老二一块往爸的病房去了。

原本王国强没什么大事，但前几天王建军还是想着给他做个全身检查，也好安心一些。

谁知道这一检查，还真查出了王国强身上有些小毛病，干脆趁着这次一块治了，就一直没让他出院。

“爸，听说你找我。”

王建军说着，走了进去，找了个板凳坐了下来。

说来也真是稀奇，王国强一般都不会主动找他，今天也算是破天荒头一回了。

“我听老二说你在县里租了个房，以后开销大了，爸上了年纪不中用，但也不会拖你的后腿。”

一听到王国强说这个，王建军就想打断他，却被王国强制止了。

“老大，你先听我说，我的意思是等回头出院了，我便和老二驾着驴车，每天给你送龙虾，这样也省着你来回跑。”

见他爸是这个意思，王建军点了点头，没再说什么。

他还以为，他爸又要说什么丧气话呢。

“家里地那事，我这几天也想过了，那地是咱家的，这钱就是我自己不拿，也该是你们俩兄弟的。”

“没道理便宜了别人，这事，老大你别管了，我回头自己弄。”

这倒是让王建军稀罕的看了王国强一眼，他爸这是怎么了？

这突然开窍了。

现在也不说什么要给老爷子养老的话了，还硬气的说要把地拿回来。

“爸，你这还生着病呢，别想那么多。”

王建军原本只当是他爸，这段时间为钱发愁的才说的这种话，急忙出声宽慰道。

谁知王国强摆了摆手，态度十分坚决，没再像以前那样窝窝囊囊的，看样子好像真打定了主意。

“怎么能不想，我这一闭眼，脑袋里全是那点事。”

“老大，你之前说的对，我对老爷子一家也算是仁至义尽了，不欠他们什么，但是该咱们的，我还是一定要讨回来的。”

王国强如今也想明白了。

他不能老在后面拖自家老大的后腿了，什么事帮不上忙就算了。

该是他们的东西，他一分不少都得要回来。

见自家老爸真的想明白了，王建军心中竟然还有几分欣慰。

本来他觉得，老一辈子的思想不容易改变。

Page (1/3)

Upon hearing this, Wang Jianjun asked Li Nanzhi to come in and look at his mother, and he followed his second son to his father's ward.

Originally, there was nothing serious about Wang Guoqiang, but a few days ago, Wang Jianjun still wanted to do a full-body check-up on him to feel more at ease.

Who would have known that this examination would actually reveal some minor ailments in Wang Guoqiang's body, so they simply took advantage of this time to treat them together and never let him leave the hospital.

"Dad, I heard you were looking for me."

Wang Jianjun said, walked in, found a bench and sat down.

It's really strange to say that Wang Guoqiang usually doesn't take the initiative to find him, but today is the first time.

"I heard from the second brother that you rented a house in the county. The expenses will be high in the future. Dad is old and useless, but it won't hold you back."

As soon as Wang Guoqiang said this, Wang Jianjun wanted to interrupt him, but was stopped by Wang Guoqiang.

"Boss, please listen to me first. What I mean is that when you are discharged from the hospital, my second brother and I will drive a donkey cart and deliver lobsters to you every day. This will save you the trouble of running back and forth."

Seeing that his father meant this, Wang Jianjun nodded and said nothing more.

He thought his father was going to say something depressing again.

"I have thought about the matter at home in the past few days. The land belongs to our family. Even if I don't take the money myself, it should belong to you two brothers."

"There's no reason to give others an advantage. Boss, please leave this matter alone. I'll take care of it myself later."

This actually made Wang Jianjun give Wang Guoqiang a strange look. What happened to his father?

This suddenly enlightened me.

Now he doesn't say anything about providing for the old man in his old age, and insists on taking the land back.

"Dad, you are still sick, don't think so much."

Wang Jianjun originally thought it was his father who was worried about money during this period and said this, so he hurriedly expressed relief.

Unexpectedly, Wang Guoqiang waved his hand with a very firm attitude. He was no longer as cowardly as before, and seemed to have really made up his mind.

"How can I not think about it? When I close my eyes, all those things are on my mind."

"Boss, what you said before is right. I have been completely benevolent to the old man's family. I don't owe them anything, but I still have to get back what's ours."

Wang Guoqiang now also wants to understand.

He can't keep dragging his boss back from behind. It's okay if he can't help with anything.

It was theirs, and he had to get back every penny.

Seeing that his father really figured it out, Wang Jianjun felt a little relieved.

Originally, he thought that the thoughts of the older generation were not easy to change.
